content: Od Megeir Fiya Nẽ Isennẽya Tamo Uru
Aya sisi fiya nẽ tibog gen werĩ taka ifana fen, irokanan, “Ule fen, Negur nẽ tempel ado alta sisi wo fen, Negur yana an ganim dalesedig anĩ uwes.
Anĩ ere, tempel fofomala anĩ utor. Are to sisi wo, ere nigin, are haiden ifenẽdin. Idi foti-tu ogõ bun taun fateul anĩ lai difalauf.
Age dife di, aya neu od megeir fiya nẽ isennẽya tamo uru megeir afenẽdi di, idi 1,260 naa anidi bun wau gudũ fiya nẽ gabar difoun ken, profet od kurõ difesiyouf.”
Eneidi are oliv aa uru ado lam tutur uru, tenebur nẽ Odug wagen difaref.
Takam idi darau ifenẽdiya nigin age fouf are, yã eweid bunem wõ ye fen, idi neid kiwai tar oditekei yakur falauf. Aibem taka idi darau ifenẽdiyou fenẽ age fouf, are agef laa fouf bagai.

Tamo eneidi saa katĩ feleya nẽ megeir ado nigin, idi profet od wogõ douf sain, uyẽ to isiyouf, agef fen, idi naan falei fe di, naud wõya nigin megeir ado fen, ereb sain orodif kilei, idi ereb sane fire fire bunem teneub yũya nẽ megeir ado.
Idi Negur nẽ od kurõ fesiya bure difele di, gaar kuĩ anĩ ku isil idĩya sã bunem ulõ yeis fen, idi geid kusĩ de, wal feid fen, idenkesiyouf.
Idi neid bouweid buru taun odug anĩ nẽ naabur yenẽf, taun are yaab od bunem Sodom ado Isip dedig, an nedi Odugeg aa tetek bun dukesin.

Tamo kayau fire fire bun tamal, ibor fire fire bun tamal, od fire fire bun tamal ado, teneub fire fire bun tamal, tamo kayau idi, naa towo ado naa taka atun bun, nedi bouweid buru dile fen, mumã difouf nigin to yo douf.
Tamo kayau tenebur dibodok anidi, idi nigin waud al fe di, sifa dino fen, idi abob safina ege luwa difenẽf, ere nigin, profet uru eneidi, idi tenebur dibodok anidi darau difenẽdin.
Anĩ ere, naa towo ado naa taka atun anĩ bure fele di, mata neseya nẽ uur Negur bunem idi namedin ilen, age fe di, idi fafã de difaren. Age dife di, idi diledin are kumĩ tererẽ den.
Anĩ bure fele di, idi saa ilunem ait odug eig ye irokeneĩd mog, karĩ den, “Ilun ein useg,” yen. Age ye di, idi neid kiwai lo difeid mog, idi lalo bunem saa ilun diselen.

Sain anĩ bun bagai, mimĩ odug wõ ye di, taun anĩ bun ten tekelei adok daũ felen. Sewen tausen tamo kayau mimĩ anim idenkesin. Age fe di, idi gareya sã are kumĩ tererẽ de fen, saa ilun nẽ Negur fula fiya medeĩya difenen.
Morõ odug uyu ilen anĩ dõ fiya bure fele di, morõ odug anĩ dõ fiya mogo melsã bagai isiyou fenẽ.
Engel Taur Namba Sewen Anĩ Wese Fen
Engel namba sewen anĩ yogon taur wese fe di, saa ilun ait odug wowã ye fen, diron:

content.text: “Tenebur nẽ tano are, neda Odug ado yogon Kristus nẽ tano wõ yen,
age fe di, ĩ gai gai lo fiya nigin anĩ nẽ mudur ibodõf.”

content: Age de di, tuwenti-fo mudur adodo, Negur wagen dogo neid king nẽ sia bun dibodon wageidlẽ kuku de fen, Negur yana dales,
diron:

content.text: “Odug Negur saa ilun nẽ kusĩ tamo guri weid uyu uroudig anĩ,
õ gama ubodok, kulu ubodon, amã õ de mayok,
ere nigin, õ ogon megeir odug wale fen,
lo fiya nigin king wõ won.
Teneub ganan waud sanen, anĩ ere, ogon didi mogo isin.
Tamo gare den anĩ es fediya sain mogo isin,
ogon ferfer profet, ogon tamo kayau fateul ado,
idi ogon yanã nigin anini den anidi nanaal ado odudug,
mala solo ifenẽdiya sain mogo isin,
idi teneub daũ difef anidi daũ fediya sain mogo isin.”

content: Anĩ bure fele di, Negur nẽ tempel saa ilun kã fele di, yogon tempel namen yogon bar itenẽya nẽ bogis wõ yen. Age fe di, kolimei filiya, gurũya odug, kolimei gudũya, mimĩ ado, uyẽ ais ado odug wõ yen.
